SELECT T.FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID JOIN BOK_BOOKSET T3 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID WHERE T.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01' AND T.BUSI_TYPE = '02' AND T3.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND T.SHARE_AMT IS NOT NULL and T.FINPROD_ID in
#{assetid}
AND T.SHARE_AMT != 0
AND ((TRADE_MARKET = '01' AND T.SETTLE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{qrydate},'%Y-%m-%d')) --银行间根据交割日 OR (TRADE_MARKET != '01' AND T.TRADE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{qrydate},'%Y-%m-%d')) --交易�?根据交易�? )
GROUP BY T3.BOOKSET_ID, T.FINPROD_ID HAVING SUM((case when T.PS = 'T01' then 1 when T.PS = 'T02' then -1 when T.PS = 'T04' then 1 when T.PS = 'T23' then -1 end) * T.Share_Amt) != 0
